resources.string: ★ Show most used apps · tap to allow
Ctrl+Space opens Quick Launch from anywhere

Lets Quick Launch open when you press Ctrl+Space on a physical keyboard, from any app. Quick Launch only listens for that key combination. It does not read screen content, observe your activity, or receive any other accessibility events.
Find “Quick Launch keyboard shortcut” under Installed apps. If the switch says “Restricted setting”: open Quick Launch’s App info › ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then try again.
